external_anchor_policy: ks_facade:read_only; only KDR-01 crosses source/design boundary

visual_rules.KDES-01: kd_roof: REQUIRED volumetric roof with distinguishable plane and edge, plausible continuity above facade width; no extra inhabited storey.
visual_rules.KDES-02: kd_parapet: REQUIRED low perimeter parapet with visible thickness, compatible masonry character; no displaced sign, banner or openings.
visual_rules.KDES-03: kd_hvac: REQUIRED single compact unbranded HVAC supported on roof, behind parapet but partly visible; subordinate scale, no floating/interpenetration.

prohibitions: Do not label any design component or KDR relationship as observed source or fidelity to the unknown original rooftop.
Do not redesign, resize or move source facade openings, door, identity signs or protected source relationships to accommodate rooftop.
Do not add excluded components, extra storeys, brands, literal signage, invented microtext, real geography or reference architecture.
Do not resolve original hidden geometry, unseen interiors, detailed side/rear facades or urban continuation.
Do not replace the volumetric design with roof texture only or hide required components completely.
Do not remove observed contextual elements or change weather, wetness, wear intensity or source material identity.

presentation.scope: Extend framing upward; moderately elevated controlled oblique presentation explicitly authorized by K0 (CG-B source/mode-authority exception). Preserve facade proportions and relationships; no aerial overview, detailed side walls or hidden historical reconstruction.
